name: reading-pkm
description: A Codex plugin that packages nine skills for turning the books you have read into lenses that get called when you think. Seek / Sense / Share as an executable pipeline: fetch a book, read it with Adler's method, file it into a second brain, render it for a channel, answer the people who write back, then measure the loop.

interface.shortDescription: Turn read books into callable lenses
interface.longDescription:
A personal reading knowledge pipeline built from nine Codex skills. Get a book (book-fetch), read it with Adler's method (read-a-book), file its cards and notes into a second brain that answers questions with citations (second-brain), design the layout (scandinavian-style), turn it into a post (rednote-post), schedule it (rednote-assistant), reply to the people who write in — read-only by default, and never send without a human nod (rednote-reply), keep the copy in your own voice (human-writing), and measure the whole loop (rsi-reading).

The library lives in ./library as plain markdown, cards load on demand, and retrieval is deterministic standard-library code: no vector database, no embeddings, no resident service.
